reviewer_role: independent Phase C theory and bounded-state-machine reviewer
scope: Phase C formulation, theorem assumptions, ledger state machine, and bounded formal checker only; this approval does not certify the Phase D implementation or experimental evidence.

findings.summary: The nonzero-risk theorem now uses a common pre-outcome sigma-field fixing arrival opportunities, predictable admission indicators and route/reservation choices, and a pathwise slot-risk sum; it claims only the fixed-opportunity-cohort union bound.
Provisional settlement retains residual correction exposure, and rollover adds a temporary guard so guard plus residual remains the original reservation until authoritative finality.
Historical downward-correction credit is audit-only, excluded from admission availability, and an explicit scenario rejects over-budget reservations in two successive future windows.
Latent billable cost, observed usage-derived cost, missing telemetry, unresolved holds, and the limits of live censored-cost inference are explicitly separated.
The evaluated risk allocation, fixed utility objective, feasibility restriction, development-only coefficients, and deterministic route tie-break are explicit without an algorithmic-novelty claim.
Pending outbox claim and cancellation are mutually exclusive; ambiguous delivery retains liability; authoritative usage may prove delivery when acknowledgements are reordered.
Tenant and workload UID authorization, same-tenant concurrent records, record/aggregate equality, settlement/finality effect counts, and rejected-transition atomic no-ops are checked.

Exact correction replay is recognized by immutable payload identity before version validation and remains a no-effect success even after a later correction version; stale unseen versions remain rejected.
The formal checker binds results to the model hash, requires the semantic invariants and transition coverage, and executes explicit long traces omitted by the depth-six symmetry-reduced exploration.

D011 adds implementation-boundary assumptions for integer accounting, authenticated workload identity, synchronous Envoy enforcement, and production fail-closed configuration. It is consistent with D008-D010, explicitly disclaims novelty, and neither changes nor broadens the conditional strict-ledger result, fixed-opportunity-cohort union bound, or two-contribution ceiling.
